summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as the enabled inventory-worker systemd service under the dedicated inventorysvc account. The service remained healthy after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created the locked system account inventorysvc with a non-login shell.
Installed inventory-worker.service with User and Group set to inventorysvc and ExecStart set to the requested worker.
Restarted node1 once using systemctl reboot and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the service, account, process ownership, and worker executable recovered after reboot.

evidence.summary: The account has system UID/GID 993, a nologin shell, and a locked password; the live worker process UID matches the account UID.
The validated unit uses the requested executable and account. It was enabled, active, running, and executing /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker.

Healthy baseline boot ID 4d340bf4-0579-47f0-98c1-5c17a66d50f1 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with boot ID 788f5397-fc61-4f64-9200-33e11094b4d2. Afterward the service was enabled and active with a new inventorysvc-owned PID, zero restarts, and the original worker SHA-256.
